text:
samir: Hey team — after using the dashboard 'Upload key' flow I started getting 401s: 

samir: Example response from our service: 
```
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Invalid API key",
    "type": "invalid_api_key",
    "status": 401
  }
}
```

samir: Repro (redacted key): 
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer {"api_key":"sk_live_XXXXX"}" \n  https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/chat
```

maria: thanks — can you confirm how you prepared the file you uploaded? did it come straight from the secrets export? :thinking_face: 

samir: yep, we exported JSON from our vault (format is `{"api_key":"sk_live_..."}`) and used the dashboard 'Upload' button to add it as a key. didn't edit or paste manually. 

maria: that explains it — the dashboard stored the file contents verbatim and the system is sending whatever value was stored as the token. so the header ended up like: `Authorization: Bearer {"api_key":"sk_live_..."}` which obviously won't match a raw key. 

maria: quick repro check for anyone: if you run the same curl but with a raw token it works: 
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXXX" \n  https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/chat
```

samir: oh wow, ok that was subtle — so upload flow should probably warn if the file parses as JSON. happy to rotate the key if needed. 

chris: Agreed — creating a follow-up. Filed RG-4012 to validate uploads and show a warning + extract common fields (api_key, key) when JSON is detected. assigning to devex. :memo: 

chris: In the meantime, short-term fix for Samir: download the file, run `jq -r .api_key secret.json` (or extract the string manually) and re-save the raw token into the dashboard. That will restore requests immediately. 

samir: did that and confirmed — requests succeed again. thanks! :tada: 

maria: logging notes for support: cause = dashboard accepted JSON object and saved literal content; symptom = 401 invalid_api_key; fix = replace with raw token; mitigation = UI validation + docs update. 

infra-bot: note: created support ticket S-2026 and linked RG-4012. 

samir: leaving this here in case others hit it — might be common with vault exports. :+1:
